_comment: Questions a fresh session should answer from this repo's decision memory. must_mention terms are matched case-insensitively; any one alternative inside a nested list counts.

questions.question: Where does this repository keep shared agent memory, and why that location rather than a per-agent directory?
Does agentmemory use a database, vector store, or external service for memory? What does it use instead?
If agentmemory is installed on my machine, is it active in every git repository I open? How does a repository opt in?
In v0.5, when is a decision captured into memory, and why was per-turn capture abandoned?
What makes a commit qualify for automatic decision capture?
Where do durable architectural decisions live, and can a hook promote one automatically?
What does the SessionStart hook inject into the agent's context, in what order, and what bounds it?
What happens to memory context after Claude Code compacts the conversation?
How does a developer's session learn what changed in memory after a git pull?
Which agent runtimes does agentmemory v0.5 support, and what happened to Gemini and Codex support?
Does agentmemory ever commit or push memory files on its own?
How do I ask what has already been decided about a subsystem, and where does that search look?
